## 运行设置与原始数据

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE,
                      error = FALSE, dev = "png", fig.path = "result/report_figures/")
# GDAL 默认按内存比例分配块缓存；面向 21600 x 43200 的大栅格(例如 stell/Warner)会把缓存撑爆并使拉中失败。
# 必须在加载 terra 之前限制缓存大小。
Sys.setenv(GDAL_CACHEMAX = "256")
required_packages <- c("terra", "sf", "dplyr", "tidyr", "tibble", "ggplot2",
  "patchwork", "ggrepel", "rnaturalearth", "rnaturalearthdata", "readxl",
  "ggpubr", "gghalves", "ggh4x", "ggtext", "gtable", "rstatix", "glmnet",
  "ncdf4", "scales", "showtext", "rmarkdown", "knitr")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace,
                                              logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_packages)) stop("Please install missing packages: ",
                                  paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
invisible(lapply(c("terra", "sf", "tidyr", "tibble", "ggplot2", "patchwork",
  "ggrepel", "rnaturalearth", "readxl", "ggpubr", "gghalves", "ggh4x",
  "ggtext", "gtable", "grid", "rstatix", "glmnet", "scales", "dplyr"),
  library, character.only = TRUE))
showtext::showtext_auto(FALSE)
set.seed(123)
stopifnot(dir.exists("data"))
dir.create("result", showWarnings = FALSE)
exclude_models <- c("yang", "SDGVM", "JSBACH", "EDv3")
biome_levels <- c("Tropical Forest", "Temperate Forest", "Boreal Forest",
  "Grassland", "Shrubland", "Desert", "Savanna", "Cropland", "Tundra", "Others")
biome_abbr <- setNames(c("Trf", "Tef", "Bof", "Gra", "Shr", "Des", "Sav", "Cro", "Tun", "Oth"), biome_levels)
biome_order <- unname(biome_abbr)
load_inputs <- function(file, objects) {
  e <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  loaded <- load(file, envir = e)
  if (!all(objects %in% loaded)) stop("Missing objects in ", file)
  for (nm in objects) assign(nm, e[[nm]], envir = parent.frame())
}
load_inputs("data/forxiaohua.Rdata", c("env_site", "sr_site_all", "sr_biome_all", "sr_glo_all"))
load_inputs("data/site_biome_sr_for_xh.Rdata", "site_biome_sr_for_xh")
load_inputs("data/srdb_v51.RData", "srdb_v51")
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
```

## 全部图共用的外观设置

边框、字体和刻度在这里统一设置。彩色数据标记保留原来的含义；数学标注中的 R² 和 p 统一正体。

```{r figure-style}
FIG_STYLE <- list(family = "Arial", ink = "black", border = 0.6, tick_line = 0.4,
                  base = 11, tick = 10, dense_tick = 8, title = 12,
                  legend = 10, strip = 11, tag = 14)

# Keep the whole frame stroke inside its viewport. A normal element_rect is
# centred on the viewport edge: clip="on" removes half, clip="off" does not.
element_figure_frame <- function(...) {
  el <- element_rect(...)
  class(el) <- c("element_figure_frame", class(el))
  el
}
element_grob.element_figure_frame <- function(element, fill = NULL, ...) {
  lw <- element$linewidth
  stroke <- unit(lw * ggplot2::.pt / 96, "inches")
  rectGrob(width = unit(1, "npc") - stroke,
           height = unit(1, "npc") - stroke,
           gp = gpar(col = element$colour,
                     fill = if (is.null(fill)) element$fill else fill,
                     lwd = lw * ggplot2::.pt, lty = element$linetype))
}
registerS3method("element_grob", "element_figure_frame",
                 element_grob.element_figure_frame, envir = asNamespace("ggplot2"))

figure_theme <- function(dense = FALSE, border = TRUE) {
  tick_size <- if (dense) FIG_STYLE$dense_tick else FIG_STYLE$tick
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                        face = "plain", size = FIG_STYLE$base),
    panel.border = if (border)
      element_figure_frame(colour = FIG_STYLE$ink, fill = NA, linewidth = FIG_STYLE$border)
      else element_blank(),
    # Only panel.border draws the frame: do not double it with axis.line.
    axis.line = element_blank(), axis.line.x = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = FIG_STYLE$ink, linewidth = FIG_STYLE$tick_line),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(colour = FIG_STYLE$ink, linewidth = FIG_STYLE$tick_line),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(colour = FIG_STYLE$ink, linewidth = FIG_STYLE$tick_line),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2, "pt"),
    axis.text = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                             face = "plain", size = tick_size),
    axis.text.x = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                               face = "plain", size = tick_size),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                               face = "plain", size = tick_size),
    axis.title = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                              face = "plain", size = FIG_STYLE$title),
    axis.title.x = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                                face = "plain", size = FIG_STYLE$title),
    axis.title.y = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                                face = "plain", size = FIG_STYLE$title),
    legend.text = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                               face = "plain", size = FIG_STYLE$legend),
    legend.title = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                                face = "plain", size = FIG_STYLE$legend),
    strip.text = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                              face = "bold", size = FIG_STYLE$strip),
    strip.text.x = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                                face = "bold", size = FIG_STYLE$strip),
    strip.text.y = if (dense)
      element_markdown(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                        face = "bold", size = 10, angle = -90)
      else element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                          face = "bold", size = FIG_STYLE$strip),
    strip.background = element_rect(colour = FIG_STYLE$ink, linewidth = FIG_STYLE$border),
    plot.title = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                              face = "bold", size = FIG_STYLE$title),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                                 face = "plain", size = FIG_STYLE$legend),
    plot.tag = element_text(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink,
                            face = "bold", size = FIG_STYLE$tag)
  )
}
# Text drawn as geometry (annotations/repelled labels) does not inherit theme(text).
for (geom in c("text", "label", "text_repel", "label_repel")) {
  update_geom_defaults(geom, list(family = FIG_STYLE$family, colour = FIG_STYLE$ink))
}
```

## 站点模拟与观测（来自 _2.Rmd，V3）

```{r site-scatter}
obs_mean <- sr_site_all %>%
  filter(type == "site",
         !model %in% c("yang", "SDGVM", "JSBACH", "EDv3")) %>%
  group_by(biome) %>%
  summarise(obs_mean = mean(sr_srdb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

sim_mean <- site_biome_sr_for_xh %>%
  filter(type == "site",
         !model %in% c("yang", "SDGVM", "JSBACH", "EDv3")) %>%
  group_by(mtype, biome) %>%
  summarise(sim_mean = mean(sr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

data_all <- sim_mean %>%
  left_join(obs_mean, by = "biome") %>%
  filter(!is.na(obs_mean) & !is.na(sim_mean)) %>%
  mutate(mtype = factor(mtype, levels = c("Data Driven", "TRENDY")))

data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(mtype = recode(mtype,
                        "Data Driven" = "DDMs",
                        "TRENDY"     = "PBMs")) %>%
  mutate(mtype = factor(mtype, levels = c("DDMs", "PBMs")))   # 保持顺序

model_colors <- c("DDMs" = "#4DB6AC", "PBMs" = "#6A1B9A")

stat_list <- lapply(split(data_all, data_all$mtype), function(d) {
  fit       <- lm(sim_mean ~ obs_mean, data = d)
  slope     <- coef(fit)[2]
  intercept <- coef(fit)[1]
  r2        <- summary(fit)$r.squared
  p_val     <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 4]

  sign_str <- ifelse(intercept >= 0, " + ", " - ")
  eq_label <- paste0("y == ", round(slope, 2), " * x", sign_str, round(abs(intercept), 2))
  r2_label <- paste0("plain(R)^2 == ", round(r2, 2))
  p_label  <- if (p_val < 0.001) {
    "plain(p) < 0.001"
  } else if (p_val < 0.01) {
    "plain(p) < 0.01"
  } else if (p_val < 0.05) {
    "plain(p) < 0.05"
  } else {
    paste0("plain(p) == ", round(p_val, 2))
  }

  data.frame(mtype = unique(d$mtype),
             eq_label = eq_label, r2_label = r2_label, p_label = p_label,
             x = -Inf, y = Inf)
})
label_df <- bind_rows(stat_list)
label_df$mtype <- factor(label_df$mtype, levels = levels(data_all$mtype))

xlab_expr <- expression("Observed site-level mean "*R[s]*" (g C m"^{-2}~"yr"^{-1}*")")
ylab_expr <- expression("Simulated site-level mean "*R[s]*" (g C m"^{-2}~"yr"^{-1}*")")

p <- ggplot(data_all, aes(x = obs_mean, y = sim_mean, color = mtype, fill = mtype)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed",
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = biome), size = 3.5, family = FIG_STYLE$family,
                   color = "black",
                   segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.4,
                   min.segment.length = 0, max.overlaps = Inf,
                   seed = 42, box.padding = 0.4) +
  geom_text(data = label_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = eq_label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.8,
            size = 5, family = FIG_STYLE$family, color = "black", parse = TRUE) +
  geom_text(data = label_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = r2_label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 3.8,
            size = 5, family = FIG_STYLE$family, color = "black", parse = TRUE) +
  geom_text(data = label_df, aes(x = x, y = y, label = p_label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 5.8,
            size = 5, family = FIG_STYLE$family, color = "black", parse = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_colors, guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ mtype, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = xlab_expr, y = ylab_expr) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,                 # 用 theme 控制面板为正方形，替代 coord_equal
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", color = "black", linewidth = FIG_STYLE$border),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "black"),
    axis.line   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_figure_frame(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = FIG_STYLE$border),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 8, 5, 8)
  )

p <- p + figure_theme()
ggsave("result/Rs_scatter_V3.png", p, width = 10, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
```

## 全球栅格集合均值（保留原重采样、掩膜和单位换算）

```{r spatial-means}
template <- rast(xmin = -180, xmax = 180, ymin = -90, ymax = 90,
                 resolution = 0.5, crs = "EPSG:4326")
combined_mask <- rasterize(vect(world[world$continent != "Antarctica", ]),
                           template, field = 1, background = NA)
ensemble_mean <- function(folder, unit_factor = 1) {
  files <- sort(list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.tif(f)?$", full.names = TRUE))
  stopifnot(length(files) > 0)
  layers <- lapply(files, function(f) {
    r <- rast(f)
    if (!same.crs(r, template)) r <- project(r, template, method = "bilinear")
    r <- resample(r, template, method = "bilinear")
    mask(r * unit_factor, combined_mask)
  })
  app(rast(layers), mean, na.rm = TRUE)
}
r_dd <- ensemble_mean("data/spatial_ddm")
r_tr <- ensemble_mean("data/spatial_pbm", 3600 * 24 * 365 * 1000)
```

## 全球分布图与纬向剖面

```{r global-maps}
df_dd <- as.data.frame(r_dd, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
df_tr <- as.data.frame(r_tr, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
r_diff <- as.data.frame(r_tr - r_dd, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

colnames(df_dd) <- c("lon", "lat", "Rs")
colnames(df_tr) <- c("lon", "lat", "Rs")
colnames(r_diff) <- c("lon", "lat", "Rs")

upper_limit <- quantile(c(df_dd$Rs, df_tr$Rs, r_diff$Rs), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_map <- function(df, title_text) {
  ggplot(df, aes(lon, lat, fill = Rs)) +
    geom_raster() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "D",
      limits = c(0, upper_limit),
      oob    = squish,
      name   = expression(R[s]~(g~C~m^{-2}~yr^{-1}))
    ) +
    annotate("text",
             x     = -172,
             y     = -80,
             label = title_text,
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
             size  = 4, fontface = "bold",
             color = "black") +          # ← 改为黑色
    coord_cartesian(xlim   = c(-180, 180),
             ylim   = c(-90, 90),
             expand = FALSE,
             clip   = "off") +           # ← 关闭裁剪
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-180, 180, 60),
      labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "\u00b0", ifelse(x < 0, "W", "E"))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-90, 90, 30),
      labels = function(y) paste0(abs(y), "\u00b0", ifelse(y < 0, "S", "N"))
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_colorbar(
        title.position = "top",
        barwidth       = unit(4, "cm"),
        barheight      = unit(0.2, "cm")
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid        = element_blank(),   # ← 关键：去掉所有网格线
      legend.position   = c(0.58, 0.13),
      legend.direction  = "horizontal",
      legend.title      = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "black",
                              margin = margin(b = 2)),  # ← 黑色
      legend.text       = element_text(size = 8,  color = "black",
                              margin = margin(t = 2)),               # ← 黑色
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
      plot.title        = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
      panel.background  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
      panel.border      = element_figure_frame(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = FIG_STYLE$border),
      axis.text         = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.title        = element_blank()
    )
}

p_dd <- plot_map(df_dd, "DDMs")

p_tr <- plot_map(df_tr, "PBMs")

df_dd$type <- "Data-driven"
df_tr$type <- "TRENDY"
df_all <- rbind(df_dd, df_tr)

grad_lat <- df_all %>%
  group_by(lat, type) %>%
  summarise(mean_Rs = mean(Rs, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_lat <- ggplot(grad_lat, aes(x = lat, y = mean_Rs, color = type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Data-driven" = "#4DB6AC", "TRENDY" = "#6A1B9A"),
  labels = c("Data-driven" = "DDMs", "TRENDY" = "PBMs")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(-90, 90, 30),
    labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "\u00b0", ifelse(x < 0, "S", "N"))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +          # ← 换成和 plot_map 一样的 base
  labs(
    x = "Latitude", y = expression(R[s]~(g~C~m^{-2}~yr^{-1})),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +          # ← 换成和 plot_map 一样的 base
  theme(
    plot.title        = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid        = element_blank(),   # ← 和 plot_map 一致：去掉网格
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    panel.border      = element_figure_frame(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = FIG_STYLE$border),  # ← 黑框
    axis.text         = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
    legend.position   = c(0.65, 0.90),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA)
  )

p_dd <- p_dd + figure_theme()
p_tr <- p_tr + figure_theme()
p_lat <- p_lat + figure_theme()
p_glo_map_Rs <- ((p_dd / p_tr) | p_lat) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(
  panel.grid        = element_blank(),   # ← 关键：去掉所有网格线
  plot.tag          = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
  plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 5, b = 0, l = 0, unit = "pt"),
  legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
  legend.text       = element_text(size = FIG_STYLE$legend)   # 只统一条目字号
)

ggsave("result/p_dd_tr.png", plot = p_glo_map_Rs, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

## 差异图与显著性标记

```{r difference-panels}
diff_mean_rast <- rast(file.path("data/for_xiaohua_diff_mean_rast.tif"))
df_diff <- as.data.frame(diff_mean_rast, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(df_diff) <- c("lon", "lat", "Rs")

diff_abs_max <- quantile(abs(df_diff$Rs), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
diff_limit <- max(diff_abs_max, 100)   # 至少100，避免范围太小

p_value_rast <- rast(file.path("data/for_xiaohua_p_value_rast.tif"))

global(p_value_rast, range, na.rm = TRUE)

if (!compareGeom(p_value_rast, diff_mean_rast, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
  p_value_rast <- resample(p_value_rast, diff_mean_rast, method = "near")
}

sig_bin <- ifel(p_value_rast < 0.05, 1, 0)
sig_bin <- mask(sig_bin, diff_mean_rast)

fact    <- 4                       # 0.5° × 4 = 2° 的打点间距；点太密就调大
sig_agg <- aggregate(sig_bin, fact = fact, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
sig_agg <- ifel(sig_agg >= 0.5, 1, NA)

df_sig <- as.data.frame(sig_agg, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(df_sig) <- c("lon", "lat", "sig")
nrow(df_sig)   # 建议控制在 800~2500；超了就把 fact 调大

Y_NPC <- 0.10
Y_DAT <- Y_NPC * 180 - 90        # = -72

to_dat <- function(x_npc) x_npc * 360 - 180

BAR_RIGHT <- 0.72                # ★ 色带整块的右边缘(npc)。调大 = 色带往右
GAP       <- 8                   # ★ 色带右缘 → 点 的间隙(单位:经度°)。调小 = 靠得更近

X_DOT <- to_dat(BAR_RIGHT) + GAP
X_TXT <- X_DOT + 6               # 文字紧跟点后

plot_diff_map <- function(df, df_sig = NULL) {

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(lon, lat, fill = Rs)) +
    geom_raster()

  if (!is.null(df_sig)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = df_sig, aes(x = lon, y = lat),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 size = 0.6, stroke = 0, colour = "black", alpha = 0.85)
  }

  p +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#4DB6AC", mid = "white", high = "#9C4DCC",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-diff_limit, diff_limit),
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = expression(Delta~R[s]~(g~C~m^{-2}~yr^{-1}))
    ) +

    annotate("text", x = -175, y = Y_DAT,
             label = "bold(Delta * R[s] == PBMs - DDMs)",
             parse = TRUE, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
             size = 5, colour = "black") +

    annotate("point", x = X_DOT, y = Y_DAT,
             shape = 16, size = 1.2, colour = "black") +
    annotate("text",  x = X_TXT, y = Y_DAT, label = "p < 0.05",
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 4, colour = "black") +

    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90),
                    expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-180, 180, 60),
                       labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "\u00b0", ifelse(x < 0, "W", "E"))) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-90, 90, 30),
                       labels = function(y) paste0(abs(y), "\u00b0", ifelse(y < 0, "S", "N"))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top",
                            barwidth = unit(4, "cm"), barheight = unit(0.4, "cm"))
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position      = c(BAR_RIGHT, Y_NPC),   # ★
      legend.justification = c(1, 0.5),             # ★ 改成“右边缘中点”对齐(原来是 c(0.5, 0.5))
      legend.direction     = "horizontal",
      legend.margin        = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      legend.background    = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "black",
                                  margin = margin(b = 2)),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.border = element_figure_frame(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = FIG_STYLE$border),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10),
      axis.title = element_blank()
    )
}

# df_lat_diff <- df_diff %>%

add_zero_crossings <- function(df, x = "lat", y = "mean_val") {
  df <- df %>% arrange(.data[[x]])
  n <- nrow(df)
  result <- df[0, ]  # 空模板，保留列结构

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    result <- bind_rows(result, df[i, ])

    if (i < n) {
      y1 <- df[[y]][i]
      y2 <- df[[y]][i + 1]

      if (!is.na(y1) && !is.na(y2) && y1 != 0 && y2 != 0 && sign(y1) != sign(y2)) {
        x1 <- df[[x]][i]
        x2 <- df[[x]][i + 1]
        x0 <- x1 + (0 - y1) * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1)  # 线性插值求零点纬度

        cross_row <- df[i, ]
        cross_row[[x]] <- x0
        cross_row[[y]] <- 0
        result <- bind_rows(result, cross_row)
      }
    }
  }

  result
}
```

```{r biome-bars}
sr_biome_stats_mean <- sr_biome_all %>%
  filter(between(year, 1980, 2016), !model %in% exclude_models) %>%
  group_by(biome, model, exp) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
area_lookup_clean <- sr_biome_all %>%
  group_by(model, biome) %>%
  summarise(area = mean(area, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

plot_biome_exp <- function(data, var = "slope",
                           biome_max,
                           x_min = NA) {

  biome_labels <- c(
  "Tundra" = "Tun",
  "Boreal Forest" = "Bof",
  "Tropical Forest" = "Trf",
  "Temperate Forest" = "Tef",
  "Desert" = "Des",
  "Shrubland" = "Shr",
  "Grassland" = "Gra",
  "Savanna" = "Sav",
  "Cropland" = "Cro",
  "Others" = "Oth"
)
  var <- sym(var)

  x_min <- if (is.na(x_min)) -biome_max / 5 else x_min

  axis_titles <- switch(as.character(var),
    "slope" = expression(R[s]~slope~"("*Pg~C~yr^{-2}*")"),
    "mean"  = expression(R[s]~"("*Pg~C~yr^{-1}*")"),
    paste(as.character(var))
  )

  fmt <- function(x) {
    ifelse(x == as.integer(x),
           as.character(as.integer(x)),
           format(round(x, 3), nsmall = 2))
  }

  mean_biome_exp <- data %>%
    filter(exp %in% c("S3", "S4")) %>%
    group_by(biome, exp) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(!!var, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  plot_df <- mean_biome_exp %>%
    mutate(
      biome    = factor(biome, levels = levels(data$biome)),
      row_type = factor(ifelse(exp == "S4", "S4", "TRENDY"),
                        levels = c("TRENDY", "S4")),
      y_id     = interaction(biome, row_type, sep = " | ", lex.order = TRUE),
      exp      = factor(exp, levels = c("S3", "S4"))
    ) %>%
    mutate(y_id = factor(y_id, levels = rev(levels(y_id))))

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      plot_value = value,
      value_pos  = ifelse(plot_value > 0, plot_value, 0),
      value_neg  = ifelse(plot_value < 0, plot_value, 0)
    )

  fill_map <- c("S3" = "#440154", "S4" = "#4DB6AC")

  box_df <- plot_df %>%
  distinct(biome, y_id) %>%
  mutate(y_num = as.numeric(y_id)) %>%
  group_by(biome) %>%
  summarise(ymin = min(y_num) - 0.5,
            ymax = max(y_num) + 0.5,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(y_mid = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
         biome_lab = unname(biome_labels[as.character(biome)]),
         biome_lab = ifelse(is.na(biome_lab), as.character(biome), biome_lab))

  sig_df <- data %>%
    filter(exp %in% c("S3", "S4")) %>%
    group_by(biome) %>%
    summarise(
      p_val = tryCatch(
        wilcox.test((!!var)[exp=="S3"],
                    (!!var)[exp=="S4"],
                    exact = FALSE)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(sig_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_val) ~ "",
      p_val < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_val < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_val < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"
    )) %>%
    left_join(box_df %>% select(biome, y_mid), by = "biome")

  global_exp <- mean_biome_exp %>%
    group_by(exp) %>%
    summarise(global_val = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  pct_df <- mean_biome_exp %>%
    left_join(global_exp, by = "exp") %>%
    mutate(
      pct_label  = sprintf("%.0f%%", value / global_val * 100),
      text_color = fill_map[as.character(exp)]
    ) %>%
    left_join(plot_df %>% select(biome, exp, y_id),
              by = c("biome", "exp"))

  biome_x <- x_min * 0.75
  sig_x   <- x_min * 0.1
  pct_x   <- biome_max * 1.0

  ggplot() +

    geom_rect(data = box_df,
              aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
                  ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
              fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = FIG_STYLE$border) +

    geom_col(data = plot_df,
             aes(x = value_pos, y = y_id, fill = exp),
             width = 0.65) +

    geom_col(data = plot_df,
             aes(x = value_neg, y = y_id, fill = exp),
             width = 0.65) +

    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +

    geom_text(data = box_df,
              aes(y = y_mid, label = biome_lab),
              x = biome_x, hjust = 1, size = 3.5) +

    geom_text(data = sig_df,
              aes(x = sig_x, y = y_mid, label = sig_label),
              hjust = 1, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +

    geom_text(data = pct_df,
              aes(x = pct_x, y = y_id,
                  label = pct_label,
                  color = text_color),
              hjust = 1, size = 3) +

    scale_color_identity() +

    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map,
                      breaks = c("S4", "S3"),          # 控制图例显示顺序
                      labels = c("S3" = "PBMs",
                                 "S4" = "DDMs")) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      name   = axis_titles,
      limits = c(x_min, biome_max),
      breaks = c(x_min, pretty(c(0, biome_max), n = 5)),
      labels = function(x) ifelse(x < 0, "", fmt(x))  # ← 左侧无刻度标签
    ) +

    scale_y_discrete(labels = NULL) +

    labs(fill = NULL) +

    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),

      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),

      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = c(0.7, 0.5),
      legend.direction = "vertical",
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.5, "cm"),    # ← 控制色块大小
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm"),    # ← 两项之间的垂直间距(可选)
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +

    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
}
p_biome_mean <- plot_biome_exp(sr_biome_stats_mean, var="mean", biome_max=25)

layout_design <- "
  ABBB
  CDDD
"
p_glo_Rs <- p_glo_Rs + figure_theme()
```

## 偏差校正与涌现约束的共同输入

```{r bias-data}
sr_site_filtered <- sr_site_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(!model %in% c("yang", "SDGVM", "JSBACH", "EDv3")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(type), !is.na(value), !is.na(mtype)) %>%
  group_by(biome, mtype, type) %>%
  mutate(
    Q1 = quantile(value, 0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(value, 0.75),
    IQR = Q3 - Q1,
    upper_whisker = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR,
    lower_whisker = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
  ) %>%
  filter(value <= upper_whisker & value >= lower_whisker) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## 代表性偏差校正（5000 次嵌套 bootstrap）

```{r bias-correction}
exclude_models <- c("yang", "SDGVM", "JSBACH", "EDv3")
n_biomes <- length(biome_order)

rho_by_model <- sr_site_filtered %>%
  filter(mtype == "TRENDY", !model %in% exclude_models, !is.na(value), !is.na(biome)) %>%
  mutate(biome = factor(biome_abbr[as.character(biome)], levels = biome_order)) %>%
  group_by(model, biome, type) %>%
  summarise(sim = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = sim, names_prefix = "sim_") %>%
  mutate(rho = sim_biome / sim_site) %>% filter(is.finite(rho)) %>%
  select(model, biome, rho)
valid_models <- rho_by_model %>% count(model) %>%
  filter(n == n_biomes) %>% pull(model)
rho_by_model <- rho_by_model %>% filter(model %in% valid_models)

biome_area_table <- area_lookup_clean %>%
  filter(model %in% valid_models) %>%
  group_by(biome) %>% summarise(area_m2 = median(area), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(biome = factor(biome_abbr[as.character(biome)], levels = biome_order)) %>%
  arrange(biome)

site_obs_raw <- sr_site_filtered %>%
  filter(type == "site", !is.na(sr_srdb), !is.na(biome))
if ("cell_id" %in% names(site_obs_raw)) {
  srdb_sites <- site_obs_raw %>%
    distinct(cell_id, biome, sr_srdb) %>%
    group_by(cell_id, biome) %>%
    summarise(sr_srdb_cell = mean(sr_srdb), .groups = "drop")
} else {
  one_model  <- site_obs_raw$model[1]
  srdb_sites <- site_obs_raw %>% filter(model == one_model) %>%
    transmute(cell_id = row_number(), biome, sr_srdb_cell = sr_srdb)
}
srdb_sites <- srdb_sites %>%
  mutate(biome = factor(biome_abbr[as.character(biome)], levels = biome_order))

srdb_means <- srdb_sites %>% group_by(biome) %>%
  summarise(mean_srdb = mean(sr_srdb_cell), .groups = "drop")
biome_uncorr     <- srdb_means %>% left_join(biome_area_table, by = "biome")
global_rs_uncorr <- sum(biome_uncorr$mean_srdb * biome_uncorr$area_m2) * 1e-15

rho_diag <- rho_by_model %>% group_by(biome) %>%
  summarise(ratio_PBM = mean(rho, na.rm = TRUE), n_models = n(), .groups = "drop")

set.seed(123); n_mc <- 5000
rho_sets   <- split(rho_by_model$rho,        as.character(rho_by_model$biome))
obs_sets   <- split(srdb_sites$sr_srdb_cell, as.character(srdb_sites$biome))
area_vec   <- setNames(biome_area_table$area_m2, as.character(biome_area_table$biome))
biomes_use <- Reduce(intersect, list(names(rho_sets), names(obs_sets), names(area_vec)))

corr_sample <- numeric(n_mc)
for (i in seq_len(n_mc)) {
  tot <- 0
  for (b in biomes_use) {
    rv <- rho_sets[[b]]; ov <- obs_sets[[b]]
    rho_b <- rv[sample.int(length(rv), 1)]                               # one rho per biome
    obs_b <- mean(ov[sample.int(length(ov), length(ov), replace = TRUE)])  # resample obs w/ replacement
    tot   <- tot + obs_b * rho_b * area_vec[[b]] * 1e-15
  }
  corr_sample[i] <- tot
}
mc_results <- tibble(iter = seq_len(n_mc), global_rs_corr = corr_sample)
mc_stats <- mc_results %>% summarise(
  mean_val = mean(global_rs_corr), sd_val = sd(global_rs_corr),
  ci_lo = quantile(global_rs_corr, 0.025), ci_hi = quantile(global_rs_corr, 0.975))

biome_bias_ranked <- srdb_means %>%
  left_join(rho_diag, by = "biome") %>% left_join(biome_area_table, by = "biome") %>%
  mutate(bias_per_area   = mean_srdb * (ratio_PBM - 1),
         bias_global_PgC = bias_per_area * area_m2 * 1e-15) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(bias_global_PgC)))

cat("valid PBM models    :", length(valid_models), "->", paste(valid_models, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("sum(bar bias)       :", round(sum(biome_bias_ranked$bias_global_PgC), 3), "PgC/yr\n")
cat("boot mean - baseline:", round(mc_stats$mean_val - global_rs_uncorr, 3), "PgC/yr\n")
cat("uncorrected baseline:", round(global_rs_uncorr, 3), "PgC/yr\n")
corr_col <- "#21908C"
plot_bias <- biome_bias_ranked %>%
  mutate(biome = factor(biome, levels = biome[order(abs(bias_global_PgC))]))

p_bias <- ggplot(plot_bias, aes(x = bias_global_PgC, y = biome)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40", linewidth = .5) +
  geom_col(width = .7, fill = "#21908C", colour = "black", linewidth = .3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("W=%.2f", ratio_PBM),
                x = -sign(bias_global_PgC) * 0.05 * max(abs(bias_global_PgC))),
            hjust = ifelse(plot_bias$bias_global_PgC > 0, 1, 0), size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(.18, .18))) +
  labs(x = expression(Propagated~biome~R[s]~bias~(Pg~C~yr^{-1})), y = "Biome type") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

## 涌现约束及留一交叉验证

```{r emergent-constraint}
exclude_models <- c("yang", "SDGVM", "JSBACH", "EDv3")
n_biomes <- length(biome_order)                          # biome 总数
valid_models <- sr_site_filtered %>%
  filter(mtype == "TRENDY", !model %in% exclude_models,   # 只要 TRENDY, 且不在剔除名单
         type == "biome", !is.na(value), !is.na(biome)) %>%
  distinct(model, biome) %>%                              # 每个(模型, biome)只留一条
  count(model) %>%                                        # 数每个模型覆盖了几个 biome
  filter(n == n_biomes) %>%                               # 只留覆盖全部 biome 的模型
  pull(model)

biome_area_table <- area_lookup_clean %>%
  filter(model %in% valid_models) %>%
  group_by(biome) %>%
  summarise(area_m2 = median(area), .groups = "drop") %>%     # 同一 biome 各模型面积略有差异, 取中位数
  mutate(biome = factor(biome_abbr[as.character(biome)], levels = biome_order)) %>%  # 全名换缩写
  arrange(biome)
total_area <- sum(biome_area_table$area_m2)                   # 全球陆地面积(把均值换算成总量时用)

x_site <- sr_site_filtered %>%
  filter(mtype == "TRENDY", model %in% valid_models, type == "site", !is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(x_site = mean(value), .groups = "drop")

y_global <- sr_site_filtered %>%
  filter(mtype == "TRENDY", model %in% valid_models, type == "biome", !is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(biome = factor(biome_abbr[as.character(biome)], levels = biome_order)) %>%
  group_by(model, biome) %>%
  summarise(bmean = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%         # 每个(模型, biome)的均值
  left_join(biome_area_table, by = "biome") %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(y_global = sum(bmean * area_m2) / sum(area_m2), .groups = "drop")  # 面积加权全球均值

model_df <- inner_join(x_site, y_global, by = "model")

fit <- lm(y_global ~ x_site, data = model_df)
r2  <- summary(fit)$r.squared                 # 样本内 R^2(拟合优度)
pv  <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 4]         # 斜率的 p 值
cat(sprintf("涌现关系: slope=%.3f intercept=%.2f R2=%.3f p=%.2e (n=%d)\n",
            coef(fit)[2], coef(fit)[1], r2, pv, nrow(model_df)))

loo_pred <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(model_df)), function(j)
  predict(lm(y_global ~ x_site, data = model_df[-j, ]),  # 用去掉第 j 行的数据拟合
          newdata = model_df[j, ]),                      # 预测被留出的第 j 行
  numeric(1))
y_obs   <- model_df$y_global                             # 真实(模拟)全球均值
pred_r2 <- 1 - sum((y_obs - loo_pred)^2) / sum((y_obs - mean(y_obs))^2)  # 预测 R^2(Q^2, 样本外)
rmse    <- sqrt(mean((y_obs - loo_pred)^2))              # 均方根误差
mae     <- mean(abs(y_obs - loo_pred))                   # 平均绝对误差
cat(sprintf("LOO-CV: 预测R2=%.3f RMSE=%.1f MAE=%.1f (n=%d)\n", pred_r2, rmse, mae, nrow(model_df)))

REF <- valid_models[1]
obs_rs <- sr_site_filtered %>%
  filter(model == REF, type == "site", !is.na(sr_srdb)) %>%
  pull(sr_srdb)                                          # 每个观测一个值(不做 cell 平均)
x_obs <- mean(obs_rs)                                    # 观测的站点均值
cat(sprintf("SRDB 观测: n=%d 均值=%.1f\n", length(obs_rs), x_obs))

set.seed(123); n_mc <- 5000
ecf <- numeric(n_mc); xb_store <- numeric(n_mc)
for (i in seq_len(n_mc)) {
  a  <- mean(obs_rs[sample.int(length(obs_rs), length(obs_rs), replace = TRUE)])  # ① 重采样观测求均值 a
  xb_store[i] <- a                                                                #    (存下来给关系图底部的边际)
  pr <- predict(fit, data.frame(x_site = a), interval = "prediction", level = 0.95)  # ② a 代入 fit 得预测区间
  se <- (pr[, "upr"] - pr[, "fit"]) / 1.96                                        #    由 95% 区间反推标准差
  ecf[i] <- rnorm(1, pr[, "fit"], se)                                             # ③ 从(高斯)预测分布随机抽一个
}
ec_flux  <- ecf                       # 约束后全球均值 (g C m-2 yr-1), 用于图2/图3
ec_total <- ecf * total_area * 1e-15  # 换算成全球总量 (Pg C yr-1), 用于图4
prior_flux <- model_df$y_global       # 未约束: n 个模型的全球均值(集合先验)
cat(sprintf("约束结果: %.1f g C m-2 yr-1 -> %.2f Pg C yr-1 (95%%CI %.2f-%.2f)\n",
            mean(ec_flux), mean(ec_total), quantile(ec_total, .025), quantile(ec_total, .975)))

PUR <- "#440154"; RED <- "#E8000B"; TEAL <- "#3AAFA9"; TEAL_D <- "#1F7A78"; MBLU <- "#3B8DD8"
cen <- mean(ec_flux); lo <- quantile(ec_flux, .025); hi <- quantile(ec_flux, .975)
```

## 偏差校正和涌现约束组合图（V4）

```{r bias-ec-figure}
PUR <- "#440154"

v1 <- mc_results$global_rs_corr      # 方法一:代表性偏差校正
v2 <- ec_total                       # 方法二:涌现约束
ADJ <- 2                             # 与你原来 p_density 的 adjust 一致

d1 <- density(v1, adjust = ADJ); d2 <- density(v2, adjust = ADJ)
dm <- max(d1$y, d2$y)

mk_ci <- function(v, y) data.frame(
  m  = mean(v), lo = quantile(v, .025), hi = quantile(v, .975), y = y,
  lab = sprintf("%.1f (\u00b1%.1f)", mean(v), (quantile(v,.975)-quantile(v,.025))/2))
ci1 <- mk_ci(v1, 0.18*dm)            # 方法一 CI 画高一点
ci2 <- mk_ci(v2, 0.06*dm)            # 方法二 CI 画低一点
th  <- 0.03*dm

df <- rbind(data.frame(x = v1, method = "Bias correction"),
            data.frame(x = v2, method = "Emergent constraint"))
df$method <- factor(df$method,
  levels = c("Bias correction", "Emergent constraint"))
cols <- c("Bias correction" = corr_col,
          "Emergent constraint"           = PUR)

p_both <- ggplot(df, aes(x, fill = method, colour = method)) +
  geom_density(alpha = .35, adjust = ADJ, linewidth = .8, position = "identity") +
  geom_segment(data=ci1, aes(x=lo,xend=hi,y=y,yend=y),       inherit.aes=FALSE, colour=corr_col, linewidth=1.2) +
  geom_segment(data=ci1, aes(x=lo,xend=lo,y=y-th,yend=y+th), inherit.aes=FALSE, colour=corr_col, linewidth=1.2) +
  geom_segment(data=ci1, aes(x=hi,xend=hi,y=y-th,yend=y+th), inherit.aes=FALSE, colour=corr_col, linewidth=1.2) +
  geom_point(  data=ci1, aes(x=m,y=y),                       inherit.aes=FALSE, colour=corr_col, size=4) +
  geom_text(   data=ci1, aes(x=m,y=y,label=lab),             inherit.aes=FALSE, colour=corr_col, vjust=-1.4, fontface="bold", size=4.2) +
  geom_segment(data=ci2, aes(x=lo,xend=hi,y=y,yend=y),       inherit.aes=FALSE, colour=PUR, linewidth=1.2) +
  geom_segment(data=ci2, aes(x=lo,xend=lo,y=y-th,yend=y+th), inherit.aes=FALSE, colour=PUR, linewidth=1.2) +
  geom_segment(data=ci2, aes(x=hi,xend=hi,y=y-th,yend=y+th), inherit.aes=FALSE, colour=PUR, linewidth=1.2) +
  geom_point(  data=ci2, aes(x=m,y=y),                       inherit.aes=FALSE, colour=PUR, size=4) +
  geom_text(   data=ci2, aes(x=m,y=y,label=lab),             inherit.aes=FALSE, colour=PUR, vjust=-1.4, fontface="bold", size=4.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = expression("Global R"[s]~"(Pg C yr"^{-1}*")"), y = "Probability density") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = c(0.01, 0.98),
        legend.justification = c(0, 1),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = NA))
set.seed(42)
ND    <- 20000
a     <- sample(v1, ND, replace = TRUE)    # Bias correction
b     <- sample(v2, ND, replace = TRUE)    # Emergent constraint
delta <- b - a                              # BC − EC

d_mean <- mean(delta)
d_ci   <- quantile(delta, c(.025, .975))
p_two  <- 2 * min(mean(delta > 0), mean(delta < 0))    # bootstrap 双侧 p
sig    <- !(d_ci[1] <= 0 && d_ci[2] >= 0)              # 95% CI 是否排除 0

gr  <- seq(min(c(v1, v2)), max(c(v1, v2)), length.out = 2048)
f1  <- approx(density(v1, adjust = ADJ), xout = gr)$y
f2  <- approx(density(v2, adjust = ADJ), xout = gr)$y
ovl <- sum(pmin(f1, f2, na.rm = TRUE)) * (gr[2] - gr[1])

cat(sprintf("BC mean = %.2f | EC mean = %.2f\n", mean(v1), mean(v2)))
cat(sprintf("Delta(EC-BC) = %.2f  95%%CI [%.2f, %.2f]  p = %.4f  overlap = %.2f  -> %s\n",
            d_mean, d_ci[1], d_ci[2], p_two, ovl,
            ifelse(sig, "significant", "not significant")))

p_lab <- if (p_two < 0.001) {"p < 0.001"} else {sprintf("p = %.3f", p_two)}
lab_diff <- sprintf("\u0394 = %.1f Pg C yr\u207B\u00B9\n95%% CI: [%.1f, %.1f]\n%s",
                    d_mean,d_ci[1],d_ci[2], p_lab)

p_both <- p_both +
  annotate("text",
           x = max(c(v1, v2)), y = 0.98 * dm,
           label = lab_diff, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
           size = 3.8, lineheight = 0.95, colour = "black")

p_bias <- p_bias + figure_theme()
p_both <- p_both + figure_theme()
combined <- p_bias + p_both +   # 即使前面去掉了也没关系
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.8, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(
    panel.border = element_figure_frame(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = FIG_STYLE$border),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),    # Modified: remove all internal grids
    axis.title = element_text(size = FIG_STYLE$title),
    axis.text = element_text(size = FIG_STYLE$tick),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_STYLE$tag)
  )

ggsave(filename = "result/Fig_bias_EC_combined_V4.png",
       plot = combined, width = 10, height = 4.5,
       dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## 涌现约束关系、交叉验证及约束前后密度（V2）

```{r ec-validation-figure}
PUR <- "#440154"; RED <- "red"; GRY <- "black"
cen <- mean(ec_flux); lo <- quantile(ec_flux, .025); hi <- quantile(ec_flux, .975)
gcurve <- function(v, n = 400){ m <- mean(v); s <- sd(v); xx <- seq(m-4*s, m+4*s, length.out = n)
  data.frame(x = xx, y = dnorm(xx, m, s)) }
xr <- range(model_df$x_site); yr <- range(c(model_df$y_global, lo, hi))
xspan <- diff(xr); yspan <- diff(yr)
xpad <- 0.06*xspan; ypad <- 0.08*yspan
mB <- 0.16*yspan            # 底部边际带高
mR <- 0.16*xspan            # 右侧边际带宽
xlo <- xr[1]-xpad;  xhi <- xr[2]+xpad+mR
ylo <- yr[1]-ypad-mB; yhi <- yr[2]+ypad
gb <- gcurve(xb_store)      # 底部：观测均值分布（峰朝上）
d_bot <- data.frame(x = gb$x, y = ylo + (gb$y/max(gb$y))*mB)
gr <- gcurve(ec_flux)       # 右侧：约束后全球均值分布（峰朝左）
d_rgt <- data.frame(y = gr$x, x = xhi - (gr$y/max(gr$y))*mR)
xseg <- c(xlo, xr[2]+xpad)  # 回归线限制在主数据区，不进右边际带
yseg <- coef(fit)[1] + coef(fit)[2]*xseg

obs_lo <- as.numeric(quantile(xb_store, .025))
obs_hi <- as.numeric(quantile(xb_store, .975))

ec_lab  <- sprintf("EC = %.0f \u00B1 %.0f",  cen,   (hi - lo)/2)
obs_lab <- sprintf("Obs = %.0f \u00B1 %.0f", x_obs, (obs_hi - obs_lo)/2)

p_lab <- if (pv < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else sprintf("p = %.3f", pv)
stats_lab <- sprintf("R\u00B2 = %.2f\n%s\nn = %d", r2, p_lab, nrow(model_df))

p_rel <- ggplot(model_df, aes(x_site, y_global)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = xlo, xmax = xhi, ymin = lo, ymax = hi,
           fill = RED, alpha = 0.10) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = obs_lo, xmax = obs_hi, ymin = ylo, ymax = yhi,
           fill = "grey50", alpha = 0.20) +
  annotate("segment", x = xseg[1], xend = xseg[2], y = yseg[1], yend = yseg[2],
           colour = PUR, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = cen, colour = RED, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(lo, hi), colour = RED, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(obs_lo, obs_hi), colour = GRY, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = x_obs, colour = GRY, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(data = d_bot, aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_path(data = d_rgt, aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = RED, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, colour = PUR) +
  geom_point(aes(x_obs, cen), colour = RED, size = 3.6) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = model), size = 3, colour = GRY, box.padding = 0.35,
                  max.overlaps = Inf, segment.color = "grey60", segment.size = 0.25, seed = 1) +
  annotate("label", x = xlo, y = yhi, label = stats_lab, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
           size = 4.0, label.size = 0.3, fill = "white", alpha = 0.85, lineheight = 0.95) +
  annotate("label", x = xr[2] + xpad, y = cen, label = ec_lab,
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 4.0, label.size = 0,
           fill = RED, colour = "white", alpha = 0.90) +
  annotate("label", x = x_obs, y = yhi, label = obs_lab,
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 4.0, label.size = 0,
           fill = "grey50", colour = "white", alpha = 0.90) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(xlo, xhi), ylim = c(ylo, 900), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = expression("Site-level averaged R"[s]*" (g C m"^{-2}*" yr"^{-1}*")"),
       y = expression("Global averaged R"[s]*" (g C m"^{-2}*" yr"^{-1}*")"),
       title = "a  Emergent relationship", subtitle = "PBMs (TRENDY)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"))

PUR <- "#440154"
loo_df <- data.frame(obs = y_obs, pred = loo_pred, model = model_df$model)
lm_val   <- lm(pred ~ obs, data = loo_df)          # 验证回归（预测~真实）
slope_v  <- coef(lm_val)[["obs"]]
intcpt_v <- coef(lm_val)[["(Intercept)"]]
bias_v   <- mean(loo_df$pred - loo_df$obs)         # MBE = mean(pred - obs)
val_lab <- sprintf(
  "Slope = %.2f\nIntercept = %.0f\nBias = %+.0f\nPredictive R\u00B2 = %.2f\nRMSE = %.0f\nn = %d",
  slope_v, intcpt_v, bias_v, pred_r2, rmse, nrow(loo_df))
rng <- range(c(loo_df$obs, loo_df$pred)); pad <- diff(rng)*0.10; lim <- c(rng[1]-pad, rng[2]+pad)

p_val <- ggplot(loo_df, aes(obs, pred)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = slope_v, intercept = intcpt_v, colour = PUR, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, colour = PUR) +

           size = 3.1, label.size = 0.3, fill = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  coord_equal(xlim = lim, ylim = lim) +
  labs(x = expression("Actual global average R"[s]*" (g C m"^{-2}*" yr"^{-1}*")"),
       y = expression("LOO predicted R"[s]*" (g C m"^{-2}*" yr"^{-1}*")"),
       title = "b  Leave-one-out cross-validation", subtitle = "PBMs (TRENDY)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"))
PUR <- "#440154"; RED <- "red"
mu0 <- mean(prior_flux); sd0 <- sd(prior_flux)     # 未约束（集合先验）
mu1 <- mean(ec_flux);    sd1 <- sd(ec_flux)        # 约束后
red_pct <- (1 - sd1/sd0)*100
x_rng <- range(c(mu0-3.5*sd0, mu0+3.5*sd0, mu1-3.5*sd1, mu1+3.5*sd1))
xx <- seq(x_rng[1], x_rng[2], length.out = 500)
dens <- rbind(data.frame(x = xx, y = dnorm(xx, mu0, sd0), grp = "Unconstrained"),
              data.frame(x = xx, y = dnorm(xx, mu1, sd1), grp = "Constrained"))
dens$grp <- factor(dens$grp, levels = c("Unconstrained", "Constrained"))
peak <- data.frame(grp = factor(c("Unconstrained","Constrained"),
                                levels = c("Unconstrained","Constrained")),
                   x = c(mu0, mu1),
                   y = c(dnorm(mu0, mu0, sd0), dnorm(mu1, mu1, sd1)))
inset_lab <- sprintf(
  "Unconstrained = %.0f \u00B1 %.0f\nConstrained     = %.0f \u00B1 %.0f\nUncertainty reduction = %.0f%%",
  mu0, sd0, mu1, sd1, red_pct)

p_ba <- ggplot(dens, aes(x, y, colour = grp)) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = peak, aes(x, y, label = grp, colour = grp),

  coord_cartesian(xlim = x_rng, ylim = c(0, max(peak$y)*1.22)) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"))

layout <- "
AA
BC
"

p_ba <- p_ba + figure_theme()
combined <- p_rel + p_val + p_ba  +

        panel.grid = element_blank(),    # Modified: remove all internal grids
```

## 三组 V8 半提琴图（共用最终绘图函数）

```{r violin-v8}
env_site$biome <- factor(env_site$biome, levels = biome_levels)
range_cfg <- list(
  AI = list(
    "Tropical Forest"  = c(0, 4),   "Temperate Forest" = c(0, 4),
    "Boreal Forest"    = c(0, 2.5), "Grassland"        = c(0, 2.5),
    "Shrubland"        = c(0, 2.5), "Desert"           = c(0, 1.5),
    "Savanna"          = c(0, 2),   "Cropland"         = c(0, 2),
    "Tundra"           = c(0, 3),   "Others"           = c(0, 3)

make_violin_v8 <- function(biome_pick, var_pick, filename, width, height,
                           strip_y_size = 10) {
  measure_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  png(measure_file, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", res = 96,
      type = if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "windows" else "cairo")
  measure_device <- dev.cur()
  on.exit({ dev.off(which = measure_device); unlink(measure_file) }, add = TRUE)
  dat <- violin_data %>% filter(biome %in% biome_pick, var %in% var_pick)
dat$biome <- factor(dat$biome,
                    levels = biome_pick)      # 只保留选中的几个，并按此顺序排列
dat$var   <- factor(dat$var,
                    levels = var_pick)   # ⭐ 把 var_names 改成 var_pick
stats_df <- dat %>% group_by(var, biome) %>% wilcox_test(value ~ type) %>% add_significance()
y_scales <- list()
for (v in var_pick) {          # 外层：var（对应每一行）
  for (b in biome_pick) {      # biome_levels内层：biome（对应每一列）
    y_scales[[length(y_scales) + 1]] <-
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = range_cfg[[v]][[b]],
        expand = c(0, 0.15),
        oob    = scales::squish
      )
  }
}

  var = var_pick, biome = biome_pick, stringsAsFactors = FALSE

  mutate(var = as.character(var), biome = as.character(biome)) %>%
  left_join(lim_df, by = c("var", "biome")) %>%
  mutate(value = pmin(pmax(value, lo), hi)) %>%          # 步骤 1：squish
  group_by(var, biome, type) %>%
  mutate(
    q1  = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3  = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr = q3 - q1
  ) %>%
  filter(value >= q1 - 1.5 * iqr, value <= q3 + 1.5 * iqr) %>%   # 步骤 2：须范围
  ungroup() %>%
  select(biome, var, type, value) %>%
  mutate(
    var   = factor(var,   levels = var_pick),
    biome = factor(biome, levels = biome_pick)
  )

make_lab <- function() {
  gp_line <- gpar(col = strip_line, lwd = strip_lwd)
  gTree(children = gList(
    # site/biome 只是半小提琴的图例说明，不是新的面板：
    # 面板背景和方框都设为透明，避免和上面的 Trf/Gra/Shr 等生物群系面板混淆。

    # 长度约为原来那条分隔线的三分之一。
    rectGrob(gp = gpar(fill = NA, col = NA)),
    segmentsGrob(x0 = 0.25, x1 = 0.25, y0 = 0.86, y1 = 1, gp = gp_line),
    segmentsGrob(x0 = 0.75, x1 = 0.75, y0 = 0.86, y1 = 1, gp = gp_line),
    textGrob("site",  x = 0.25, gp = gpar(col = col_site,  fontface = "bold", fontfamily = FIG_STYLE$family, fontsize = lab_fs)),
    textGrob("biome", x = 0.75, gp = gpar(col = col_biome, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = FIG_STYLE$family, fontsize = lab_fs))
  ))
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(last_pan))) {

}
```

## 全球 Rs 差异的四因子岭回归贡献

```{r ridge-contribution}
pred <- env_site %>%
  filter(type == "biome",
         !(var %in% c("Tair", "Pre") & data == "WC")) %>%   # Tair/Pre 只留 CRU
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value)) %>%              # 堵情况一:强制数值
  pivot_wider(names_from = var, values_from = value,
              id_cols = c(cell_id, x, y, biome),
              values_fn = mean)                       # 堵情况二:同键多行取均值

diff_mean_rast <- rast("data/for_xiaohua_diff_mean_rast.tif")
rs <- c(r_dd, r_tr, diff_mean_rast); names(rs) <- c("Rs_DDM", "Rs_PBM", "dRs")

pts <- vect(pred, geom = c("x", "y"), crs = crs(rs))
df  <- bind_cols(pred, terra::extract(rs, pts)[, -1])

vars4   <- c("Tair", "Pre", "LAI", "SOC")
targets <- c("Rs_DDM", "Rs_PBM", "dRs")

df_all <- df   # 保留全部预测因子，供下面的堆叠贡献图使用
df <- df %>%
  select(cell_id, x, y, biome, all_of(vars4), all_of(targets)) %>%
  drop_na(all_of(c(vars4, targets)))

# 对于目标因子 k，相对重要性 RC_k = |beta_k| / sum_{j=1}^4 |beta_j| * 100；
# k 是当前柱对应的因子，j 是分母求和时遍历四个因子的哑指标（不能把两者混为同一固定下标）。
# 相对重要性（图中柱高）= |标准化岭回归系数| / sum|标准化岭回归系数| * 100，
# 四根柱合计 100%。R2 是模型对目标变量的总体解释力（样本内 R2，lambda 由 10 折
# 交叉验证选出），单独标注在面板角落，不参与柱高的分配——这里不做严格的方差分解。
run_ridge <- function(d, yname, vars){
  d <- d %>% drop_na(all_of(c(yname, vars)))
  if (nrow(d) < 20) return(NULL)                 # 样本过少跳过
  X <- scale(as.matrix(mutate(d[vars],  # 在当前子集内 z-score
                              across(everything(), as.numeric))))
  y <- d[[yname]]
  cv <- cv.glmnet(X, y, alpha = 0, standardize = FALSE)  # alpha=0 即 ridge
  b  <- as.vector(coef(cv, s = "lambda.min"))[-1]
  yhat <- as.vector(predict(cv, newx = X, s = "lambda.min"))
  R2 <- 1 - sum((y - yhat)^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  tibble(var = vars, coef = b,
         contrib = abs(b) / sum(abs(b)) * 100,
         R2 = R2, n = nrow(d))
}

set.seed(123)
result <- run_ridge(df, "dRs", vars4) %>% mutate(scale = "Global", target = "dRs")

var_colors <- c("MAT" = "#E4211C", "MAP" = "#2E75B6",
                "LAI" = "#4DAF4A", "SOC" = "#F28E2B")
var_levels <- c("MAT", "MAP", "LAI", "SOC")

sub_df <- result %>%
  filter(target == "dRs", scale == "Global") %>%
  mutate(
    var = dplyr::recode(var, "Tair" = "MAT", "Pre" = "MAP"),
    var = factor(var, levels = var_levels)
  )

r2_val <- unique(sub_df$R2)   # 该 scale×target 唯一的 R²

p_sub <- ggplot(sub_df, aes(x = var, y = contrib, fill = var)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("text",
           x     = Inf, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("plain(R)^2 == ", sprintf("%.2f", r2_val)),
           parse = TRUE,
           hjust = 1.15, vjust = 1.8,
           size  = 3.4,  color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = var_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, NA),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))   # 顶部留白放 R² 标注
  ) +
  labs( x = "Drivers",
     y = expression("Relative importance for "~Delta*R[s]~" (% )")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),   # Modified: remove all internal grids
    legend.position    = "none",
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 10)
  )
```

```{r response-curves}
bin_eqfreq <- function(x, k, tail = 1) {
  p <- seq(0, 1, length.out = k + 1)
  if (tail != 1) {
    p <- ifelse(p < 0.5,
                0.5 * (2 * p)^tail,
                1 - 0.5 * (2 * (1 - p))^tail)
  }
  br <- unique(quantile(x, probs = p, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (length(br) < 2) return(rep(1L, length(x)))
  cut(x, breaks = br, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
}

binned_all <- dat_all %>%
  left_join(bin_cfg, by = c("series", "variable")) %>%
  group_by(series, variable) %>%
  mutate(bin = bin_eqfreq(x_value, k = k[1], tail = tail[1])) %>%
  group_by(series, variable, bin) %>%
  summarise(x    = median(x_value),          # 尾部箱很宽, median 比 mean 稳
            n    = n(),
            mu   = mean(y),
            y_sd = sd(y),
            y_se = sd(y) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(y_sd = coalesce(y_sd, 0),
         y_se = coalesce(y_se, 0)) %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = c("pre", "lai")),
         series   = factor(series,   levels = c("DDMs", "PBMs", "SRDB")))

make_panel <- function(var, err = c("SE", "SD"), legend = TRUE) {

  err <- match.arg(err)

  d <- binned_all %>%
    filter(variable == var) %>%
    mutate(e    = if (err == "SE") y_se else y_sd,
           ymin = mu - e,
           ymax = mu + e)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = x, y = mu, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, color = series)) +

    geom_pointrange(shape = 16, size = pt_size, linewidth = ln_width) +

    scale_color_manual(values = col_map,
                       breaks = c("DDMs", "PBMs", "SRDB"), name = NULL) +

    labs(x = parse(text = var_labels[[var]])[[1]],
         y = expression(R[s] ~ (gC ~ m^{-2} ~ yr^{-1}))) +

    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid           = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x         = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position      = if (legend) c(0.01, 0.99) else "none",
      legend.justification = c(0, 1),
      legend.background    = element_blank(),
      legend.key           = element_blank())
}

p_map <- make_panel("pre", "SE")   # b
p_lai <- make_panel("lai", "SE")   # c

theme_common <- figure_theme() + theme(
  plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5, unit = "pt"),  # 重点：底部留更多空间
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = FIG_STYLE$title, margin = margin(r = 5, unit = "pt"))
)

# ggplot2 按文本外框放置 x 轴标题：纯文本 "Drivers" 与含括号和上标的 plotmath
# 标题（MAP (mm yr-1)、LAI (m2 m-2)）外框高度不同，因此不会落在同一条基线上。
# 这里分别给三个面板设置 vjust（Arial 12 pt 下实测），让三条 x 轴标题对齐到
# 同一条水平线上。改动 x 轴标题文字后需要重新标定这两个数值。
theme_x_title <- function(vjust) {
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = FIG_STYLE$title, vjust = vjust,
                                    margin = margin(t = 5, unit = "pt")))
}

p_sub_new <- p_sub + theme_common + theme_x_title(0.30)
p_map_new <- p_map + theme_common + theme_x_title(0)
p_lai_new <- p_lai + theme_common + theme_x_title(0)

p_all <- p_sub_new + p_map_new + p_lai_new +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = FIG_STYLE$tag, face = "bold"))  # 4mm -> pt, 和原来 geom_text(size=4) 等大

p_all


ggsave("result/Rs_RC_SE_2factors_V7.png", p_all, width = 9, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## 四因子相对贡献堆叠图：DDMs 与 PBMs（全球 + Trf/Gra/Shr/Des，V1）

```{r contribution-stack}
# 对于目标因子 k，每根柱子的相对贡献 RC_k = |beta_k| /
# sum_{j=1}^4 |beta_j|；k 指当前因子，j 遍历四个因子。因此每根柱子合计 100%。
# 预测因子在 ridge_stack_vars 里一处定义：MAT / MAP / LAI / SOC。
ridge_stack_vars   <- c("Tair", "Pre", "LAI", "SOC")      # MAT, MAP, LAI, SOC
ridge_stack_labels <- c(Tair = "MAT", Pre = "MAP", LAI = "LAI", SOC = "SOC")
ridge_stack_levels <- c("Glo", "Trf", "Gra", "Shr", "Des")
ridge_stack_biomes <- list(
  Glo = NULL,
  Trf = "Tropical Forest",
  Gra = "Grassland",
  Shr = "Shrubland",
  Des = "Desert"
)
ridge_stack_colors <- c(MAT = "#E4211C", MAP = "#2E75B6",
                        LAI = "#4DAF4A", SOC = "#F28E2B")
ridge_stack_targets <- c(Rs_DDM = "DDMs", Rs_PBM = "PBMs")

stack_df <- df_all %>%
  select(biome, all_of(ridge_stack_vars), all_of(names(ridge_stack_targets))) %>%
  drop_na()

stack_res <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ridge_stack_biomes), function(g) {
  sub <- if (is.null(ridge_stack_biomes[[g]])) {
    stack_df
  } else {
    stack_df %>% filter(biome == ridge_stack_biomes[[g]])
  }
  bind_rows(lapply(names(ridge_stack_targets), function(tg) {
    r <- run_ridge(sub, tg, ridge_stack_vars)
    if (is.null(r)) return(NULL)
    r %>% mutate(group = g, target = unname(ridge_stack_targets[[tg]]))
  }))
}))

stack_res <- stack_res %>%
  mutate(
    var    = factor(unname(ridge_stack_labels[as.character(var)]),
                     levels = c("MAT", "MAP", "LAI", "SOC")),
    group  = factor(group, levels = ridge_stack_levels),
    target = factor(target, levels = c("DDMs", "PBMs"))
  )

stack_r2 <- stack_res %>% distinct(group, target, R2)

make_stack_panel <- function(target_name) {
  d  <- stack_res %>% filter(target == target_name)
  r2 <- stack_r2  %>% filter(target == target_name)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = group, y = contrib, fill = var)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.68, color = "white", linewidth = 0.25,
             position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
    # R2 是模型对目标变量的整体解释力，与纵轴的相对重要性百分比是两个量，
    # 因此单独标注在面板角落，不放进 y 轴。
    geom_text(data = r2,
              aes(x = group, y = 104.5, label = sprintf("R^2 == '%.2f'", R2)),
              color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 3.2,
              parse = TRUE, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = ridge_stack_colors, name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 110), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative importance (% )") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

p_stack_ddm <- make_stack_panel("DDMs") + figure_theme() +
  labs(title = "DDMs") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(3.5, "mm"),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
p_stack_pbm <- make_stack_panel("PBMs") + figure_theme() +
  labs(title = "PBMs") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(3.5, "mm"),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
        axis.title.y = element_blank())

p_stack <- (p_stack_ddm | p_stack_pbm) +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = FIG_STYLE$tag, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("result/Rs_contrib_stack_2models_V1.png", p_stack,
       width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r model-biome-boxplots}
# 配色与半提琴图一致：site 用青色、biome 用紫色；
```

## 三个 NetCDF：DDM 土壤呼吸、PBMs 土壤呼吸、环境变量与生物群系

```{r netcdf}
# 三个 NetCDF 及其同名变量表统一输出到 result/zenodo/，该目录内容用于上传 Zenodo
out_dir <- file.path("result", "zenodo")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
as_number <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))

safe_nc_names <- function(x) {
  y <- iconv(as.character(x), to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT")
  y[is.na(y)] <- "variable"
  y <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", y)
  y <- gsub("_+", "_", y)
  y <- sub("^([^A-Za-z_])", "v_\\1", y)
  y <- ifelse(nchar(y) == 0, "variable", y)
  make.unique(y, sep = "_")
}

align_to_ref <- function(r, ref, method = "bilinear") {
  same_crs <- tryCatch(terra::same.crs(r, ref), error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (!same_crs) {
    r <- terra::project(r, ref, method = method)
  } else if (!terra::compareGeom(r, ref, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
    r <- terra::resample(r, ref, method = method)
  }
  r
}

lsm_all <- terra::rast("data/for_xiaohua_lsm_stack.tif")
ml_all  <- terra::rast("data/for_xiaohua_ml_stack.tif")
drop_models <- c("yang", "SDGVM", "JSBACH", "EDv3")
is_dropped <- function(nm) vapply(nm, function(z)
  any(vapply(drop_models, function(d) grepl(d, z, ignore.case = TRUE), logical(1))),
  logical(1))
lsm_use <- lsm_all[[which(!is_dropped(names(lsm_all)))]]
ml_use  <- ml_all [[which(!is_dropped(names(ml_all)))]]
if (nlyr(lsm_use) != 11L || nlyr(ml_use) != 10L) {
  stop("Expected 11 PBM and 10 DDM layers after filtering; got ",
       nlyr(lsm_use), " PBM and ", nlyr(ml_use), " DDM layers.")
}
ref_grid <- ml_use[[1]]
lsm_use <- align_to_ref(lsm_use, ref_grid)
ml_use  <- align_to_ref(ml_use, ref_grid)

env_map <- data.frame(
  source = c("Tair", "Pre", "LAI", "SOC", "GPP", "AI", "swc"),
  name   = c("MAT", "MAP", "LAI", "SOC", "GPP", "AI", "SWC"),
  units  = c("degC", "mm yr-1", "m2 m-2", "kg C m-2", "g C m-2 yr-1", "1", "m3 m-3"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
if (!exists("env_site") || !all(c("x", "y", "var", "value", "type") %in% names(env_site))) {
  stop("env_site is not available or lacks x, y, var, value and type columns.")
}
env_df <- env_site %>%
  filter(type == "biome", var %in% env_map$source,
         !(var %in% c("Tair", "Pre") & data == "WC")) %>%
  transmute(x = as_number(x), y = as_number(y), var = as.character(var),
            value = as_number(value)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y), is.finite(value)) %>%
  group_by(x, y, var) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(value = if_else(var == "SOC", value * 100, value))

env_list <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(env_map))) {
  src <- env_map$source[i]
  sub <- env_df %>% filter(var == src) %>% select(x, y, value)
  if (!nrow(sub)) {
    warning("No values found for environmental variable ", src, "; it is omitted.")
    next
  }
  r <- terra::rast(sub, type = "xyz", crs = terra::crs(ref_grid))
  r <- align_to_ref(r, ref_grid, method = "bilinear")
  names(r) <- env_map$name[i]
  env_list[[env_map$name[i]]] <- r
}
if (!length(env_list)) stop("No environmental layers could be built from env_site.")
env_stack <- do.call(c, unname(env_list))

biome_levels <- c("Tropical Forest", "Temperate Forest", "Boreal Forest",
                  "Grassland", "Shrubland", "Desert", "Savanna",
                  "Cropland", "Tundra", "Others")
biome_df <- env_site %>%
  filter(type == "biome", !is.na(biome), biome != "") %>%
  transmute(x = as_number(x), y = as_number(y), biome = as.character(biome)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(x), is.finite(y)) %>%
  group_by(x, y) %>% slice(1L) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(biome_code = match(biome, biome_levels)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(biome_code))
if (!nrow(biome_df)) stop("No biome grid cells could be built from env_site.")
r_biome <- terra::rast(biome_df %>% select(x, y, biome_code),
                       type = "xyz", crs = terra::crs(ref_grid))
r_biome <- align_to_ref(r_biome, ref_grid, method = "near")
names(r_biome) <- "biome_code"

pbm_source <- names(lsm_use)
ddm_source <- names(ml_use)
env_source <- env_map$name[env_map$name %in% names(env_stack)]

# 输出拆成三个文件：DDM 土壤呼吸、PBMs 土壤呼吸、环境变量 + 生物群系
nc_env <- safe_nc_names(c("biome_code", env_source))
nc_pbm <- safe_nc_names(paste0("Rs_PBM_", pbm_source))
nc_ddm <- safe_nc_names(paste0("Rs_DDM_", ddm_source))
if (anyDuplicated(c(nc_env, nc_pbm, nc_ddm))) {
  stop("NetCDF variable names are not unique across the three files.")
}

names(r_biome)   <- nc_env[1]
names(env_stack) <- nc_env[seq_len(nlyr(env_stack)) + 1L]
names(lsm_use)   <- nc_pbm
names(ml_use)    <- nc_ddm

env_biome_stack <- c(r_biome, env_stack)
pbm_stack <- lsm_use
ddm_stack <- ml_use

meta_env <- data.frame(
  nc_name = names(env_biome_stack),
  source_name = c("biome_code", env_source),
  long_name = c(
    "Biome / landcover type (1-10 code)",
    paste0(env_source, " global product")
  ),
  units = c("categorical", env_map$units[match(env_source, env_map$name)]),
  group = c("biome", rep("env_factor", nlyr(env_stack))),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
meta_pbm <- data.frame(
  nc_name = names(pbm_stack),
  source_name = pbm_source,
  long_name = paste0("Soil respiration from PBM ", pbm_source),
  units = rep("g C m-2 yr-1", nlyr(pbm_stack)),
  group = rep("model_PBM", nlyr(pbm_stack)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
meta_ddm <- data.frame(
  nc_name = names(ddm_stack),
  source_name = ddm_source,
  long_name = paste0("Soil respiration from DDM ", ddm_source),
  units = rep("g C m-2 yr-1", nlyr(ddm_stack)),
  group = rep("model_DDM", nlyr(ddm_stack)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

add_meta_stats <- function(meta_df, stack) {
  meta_df$n_valid <- vapply(seq_len(nlyr(stack)), function(i)
    sum(!is.na(terra::values(stack[[i]]))), numeric(1))
  meta_df$min <- vapply(seq_len(nlyr(stack)), function(i)
    suppressWarnings(min(terra::values(stack[[i]]), na.rm = TRUE)), numeric(1))
  meta_df$max <- vapply(seq_len(nlyr(stack)), function(i)
    suppressWarnings(max(terra::values(stack[[i]]), na.rm = TRUE)), numeric(1))
  meta_df
}
meta_env <- add_meta_stats(meta_env, env_biome_stack)
meta_pbm <- add_meta_stats(meta_pbm, pbm_stack)
meta_ddm <- add_meta_stats(meta_ddm, ddm_stack)

write_nc_stack <- function(path, stack, meta_df, title, var_atts = list()) {
  lon <- terra::xFromCol(ref_grid, seq_len(ncol(ref_grid)))
  lat <- terra::yFromRow(ref_grid, seq_len(nrow(ref_grid)))
  dlon <- ncdf4::ncdim_def("lon", "degrees_east", lon)
  dlat <- ncdf4::ncdim_def("lat", "degrees_north", rev(lat))
  vars <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(meta_df)), function(i)
    ncdf4::ncvar_def(meta_df$nc_name[i], meta_df$units[i], list(dlon, dlat), -9999,
                     longname = meta_df$long_name[i], prec = "float", compression = 4))
  nc <- ncdf4::nc_create(path, vars, force_v4 = TRUE)
  on.exit(ncdf4::nc_close(nc))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(meta_df))) {
    z <- terra::as.matrix(stack[[i]], wide = TRUE)
    stopifnot(all(dim(z) == c(nrow(ref_grid), ncol(ref_grid))))
    z <- t(z[nrow(z):1, , drop = FALSE])
    ncdf4::ncvar_put(nc, vars[[i]], z)
    if (meta_df$nc_name[i] %in% names(var_atts)) {
      for (nm in names(var_atts[[meta_df$nc_name[i]]])) {
        att_value <- var_atts[[meta_df$nc_name[i]]][[nm]]
        if (nm == "flag_values") {
          ncdf4::ncatt_put(nc, meta_df$nc_name[i], nm, att_value, prec = "integer")
        } else {
          ncdf4::ncatt_put(nc, meta_df$nc_name[i], nm, att_value)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  ncdf4::ncatt_put(nc, 0, "title", title)
  invisible(path)
}

nc_outputs <- list(
  list(nc = "RsBias_DDM_soil_respiration.nc",
       stack = ddm_stack, meta = meta_ddm,
       title = "Global soil respiration from data-driven models (DDMs)",
       atts = list()),
  list(nc = "RsBias_PBM_soil_respiration.nc",
       stack = pbm_stack, meta = meta_pbm,
       title = "Global soil respiration from process-based models (PBMs)",
       atts = list()),
  list(nc = "RsBias_env_biome.nc",
       stack = env_biome_stack, meta = meta_env,
       title = "Global environmental factors and biome",
       atts = list(biome_code = list(
         flag_values = seq_along(biome_levels),
         flag_meanings = paste(gsub(" ", "_", biome_levels), collapse = " ")
       )))
)

for (o in nc_outputs) {
  write_nc_stack(file.path(out_dir, o$nc), o$stack, o$meta, o$title, o$atts)
  write.csv(o$meta,
            file.path(out_dir, sub("\\.nc$", "_variables.csv", o$nc)),
            row.names = FALSE)
}

# 旧的合并文件不再输出
for (f in file.path(out_dir, c("RsBias_global_combined.nc",
                               "RsBias_global_combined_variables.csv"))) {
  if (file.exists(f)) file.remove(f)
}
```

## 输出完整性与 NetCDF 回读核对

```{r verify}
expected_png <- c("site_distribution_map_V2.png", "Rs_scatter_V3.png", "bar_4Figs_v7.png",
 "Rs_RC_SE_2factors_V7.png", "Rs_contrib_stack_2models_V1.png",
 "Rs_model_biome_boxplots_V1.png",
 "violin_4vars_x_4biomes_Rs_V8.png", "violin_5vars_x_4biomes_Rs_V8.png",
 "violin_9vars_x_6biomes_Rs_V8.png", "Fig_bias_EC_combined_V4.png", "p_dd_tr.png",
 "Fig_rel_val_ba_V2.png")
stopifnot(all(file.exists(file.path("result", expected_png))))

expected_nc <- vapply(nc_outputs, function(o) o$nc, character(1))
expected_csv <- sub("\\.nc$", "_variables.csv", expected_nc)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(file.path(out_dir, expected_nc))))
stopifnot(all(file.exists(file.path(out_dir, expected_csv))))

verify_one_nc <- function(o) {
  nc <- ncdf4::nc_open(file.path(out_dir, o$nc))
  on.exit(ncdf4::nc_close(nc))
  stopifnot(identical(names(nc$var), o$meta$nc_name),
            length(nc$var) == nrow(o$meta))
  expected_lon <- xFromCol(ref_grid, seq_len(ncol(ref_grid)))
  expected_lat <- rev(yFromRow(ref_grid, seq_len(nrow(ref_grid))))
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(nc$dim$lon$vals), expected_lon)),
            isTRUE(all.equal(as.numeric(nc$dim$lat$vals), expected_lat)))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(o$meta))) {
    expected <- t(terra::as.matrix(o$stack[[i]], wide = TRUE)[nrow(ref_grid):1, , drop = FALSE])
    actual <- ncdf4::ncvar_get(nc, o$meta$nc_name[i])
    stopifnot(identical(dim(actual), dim(expected)), identical(is.na(actual), is.na(expected)))
    ok <- is.finite(expected)
    stopifnot(all(abs(actual[ok] - expected[ok]) <= 1e-6 * pmax(1, abs(expected[ok]))))
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
verify_netcdf <- function() {
  for (o in nc_outputs) verify_one_nc(o)
  invisible(TRUE)
}
verify_netcdf()
message("Verified: ", length(expected_png), " PNG figures, ",
        length(expected_nc), " NetCDF files and their metadata CSV files.")
```
